statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.IsAcyclic) (he : G.edgeFinset.Nonempty) : ∃ v, G.degree v = 1
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.IsAcyclic → G.edgeFinset.Nonempty → ∃ v, G.degree v = 1
informal: A finite forest with at least one edge has a leaf — let W = {v | deg v ≥ 1} (nonempty by he) and H = G.induce W, which is acyclic (map a cycle along the embedding) and has the same degrees as G on W since all neighbours of a vertex lie in W; if no vertex had degree 1 then all degrees in H are ≥ 2 and Uses Mathlib2.comb_not_acyclic_of_two_le_degree at this step on H for a contradiction.

name: gr_exists_indepSet_card_ge
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (h : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ d) : ∃ s : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V) ∧ Fintype.card V ≤ (d + 1) * s.card
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ), (∀ (v : V), G.degree v ≤ d) → ∃ s, G.IsIndepSet ↑s ∧ Fintype.card V ≤ (d + 1) * s.card
informal: A graph of maximum degree ≤ d has an independent set of size ≥ n/(d+1) — Uses Mathlib2.comb_colorable_of_degree_le at step 1 to get a colouring C : G.Coloring (Fin (d+1)); by pigeonhole (Finset.exists_lt_card_fiber_of... / sum of fibre sizes = n) some colour class has (d+1)·|class| ≥ n, and colour classes are independent.

name: p6_addition
statement: (k m n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (m + n) = p6_kfib k m * p6_kfib k (n + 1) + p6_kfib k (m - 1) * p6_kfib k n ∧ p6_kfib k (m + n + 1) = p6_kfib k (m + 1) * p6_kfib k (n + 1) + p6_kfib k m * p6_kfib k n
type: ∀ (k m n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (m + n) = Mathlib2.p6_kfib k m * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) + Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (m - 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n ∧ Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (m + n + 1) = Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (m + 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) + Mathlib2.p6_kfib k m * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n
informal: Proof of Lemma 2.3 (unnumbered): f_{m+n} = f_m f_{n+1} + f_{m-1} f_n and companion f_{m+n+1} = f_{m+1} f_{n+1} + f_m f_n [All integers m, n.]

name: p6_lem23_eq6
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (2 * n) = p6_kfib k n * (p6_kfib k (n - 1) + p6_kfib k (n + 1))
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n) = Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n * (Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n - 1) + Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1))

name: gr_ramsey_three_four_le_nine
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (h : 9 ≤ Fintype.card V) (G : SimpleGraph V) : ¬ G.CliqueFree 3 ∨ ¬ Gᶜ.CliqueFree 4
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V], 9 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V), ¬G.CliqueFree 3 ∨ ¬Gᶜ.CliqueFree 4
informal: R(3,4) ≤ 9 — reduce to card V = 9 (restrict to a 9-subset) and argue by contradiction: as in the 10-vertex bound every vertex has degree ≤ 3 (4 pairwise non-adjacent neighbours give an independent 4-set) and at most 5 non-neighbours (Uses Mathlib2.r3_ramsey_three_three at this step on 6 non-neighbours), so every degree is exactly 3; then ∑deg = 27 is odd, contradicting the handshake lemma.

name: p6_lem23_eq7
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) = p6_kfib k n ^ 2 + p6_kfib k (n + 1) ^ 2
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) = Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n ^ 2 + Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) ^ 2

name: p6_lem23_eq8
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (n - 1) * p6_kfib k (n + 1) - p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ((Int.negOnePow n : ℤˣ) : ℤ)
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n - 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) - Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ↑n.negOnePow
informal: Lemma 2.3 (8) Cassini: f_{n-1} f_{n+1} - f_n^2 = (-1)^n [(-1)^n for integer n is Mathlib's Int.negOnePow.]

name: gr_goodman_six_two_mono_triangles
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : Fintype.card V = 6) : 2 ≤ (G.cliqueFinset 3).card + (Gᶜ.cliqueFinset 3).card
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], Fintype.card V = 6 → 2 ≤ (G.cliqueFinset 3).card + (Gᶜ.cliqueFinset 3).card
informal: Goodman: any 2-colouring of the edges of K₆ has at least two monochromatic triangles (strengthens Mathlib2.r3_ramsey_three_three, which gives one) — count non-monochromatic triangles: each has exactly two vertices where its two edges differ in colour, so their number is ½∑_v deg(v)(5 − deg(v)) ≤ ½·6·6 = 18, and 20 − 18 = 2.

name: gr_triangle_count_lower_bound
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2 * G.edgeFinset.card + 3 * Fintype.card V * (G.cliqueFinset 3).card
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2 * G.edgeFinset.card + 3 * Fintype.card V * (G.cliqueFinset 3).card
informal: Quantitative Mantel (Moon–Moser/Nordhaus–Stewart): a graph has at least e(4e − n²)/(3n) triangles; for triangle-free G this recovers Mathlib2.bld_mantel_triangle_free — for each edge uv the number of triangles on it is ≥ deg u + deg v − n; summing over edges gives 3t ≥ ∑deg² − n·e, and Cauchy–Schwarz ∑deg² ≥ (2e)²/n finishes.

name: p6_lem23_eq9
statement: (k n : ℤ) : p6_kfib k (n + 1) ^ 2 - k * p6_kfib k n * p6_kfib k (n + 1) - p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ((Int.negOnePow n : ℤˣ) : ℤ)
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) ^ 2 - k * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1) - Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n ^ 2 = ↑n.negOnePow

name: p6_lem23_eq10
statement: (k a b : ℤ) : p6_kfib k a * p6_kfib k (b + 1) - p6_kfib k (a + 1) * p6_kfib k b = ((Int.negOnePow b : ℤˣ) : ℤ) * p6_kfib k (a - b)
type: ∀ (k a b : ℤ), Mathlib2.p6_kfib k a * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (b + 1) - Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (a + 1) * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k b = ↑b.negOnePow * Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (a - b)
informal: Lemma 2.3 (10) d'Ocagne: f_a f_{b+1} - f_{a+1} f_b = (-1)^b f_{a-b}

name: gr_five_no_mono_triangle_degree_two
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h5 : Fintype.card V = 5) (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (hc : Gᶜ.CliqueFree 3) (v : V) : G.degree v = 2
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], Fintype.card V = 5 → G.CliqueFree 3 → Gᶜ.CliqueFree 3 → ∀ (v : V), G.degree v = 2
informal: In a 2-colouring of K₅ without monochromatic triangle every vertex has red degree 2 (so the colouring is the pentagon) — if deg v ≥ 3 then three neighbours are pairwise non-adjacent (G triangle-free) hence a triangle of Gᶜ; if deg v ≤ 1 then v has ≥ 3 non-neighbours, pairwise adjacent in G (Gᶜ triangle-free), a triangle of G.

name: gr_nordhaus_gaddum_mul
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : ℕ) (ha : G.Colorable a) (hb : Gᶜ.Colorable b) : Fintype.card V ≤ a * b
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : ℕ), G.Colorable a → Gᶜ.Colorable b → Fintype.card V ≤ a * b
informal: Nordhaus–Gaddum product bound χ(G)·χ(Gᶜ) ≥ n — with colourings c₁ : V → Fin a of G and c₂ : V → Fin b of Gᶜ the map v ↦ (c₁ v, c₂ v) is injective, since distinct u,v are adjacent in G or in Gᶜ; compare cardinalities.

name: p6_coprime
statement: (k n : ℤ) : IsCoprime (p6_kfib k n) (p6_kfib k (n + 1))
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), IsCoprime (Mathlib2.p6_kfib k n) (Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (n + 1))
informal: After Lemma 2.3 (unnumbered): gcd(f_n, f_{n+1}) = 1

name: p6_odd_pos
statement: (k n : ℤ) : 0 < p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), 0 < Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)
informal: Sec 3 (unnumbered): Note that f_{2n+1} > 0, since it is a sum of squares

name: gr_card_le_colorable_mul_indep
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k a : ℕ) (hk : G.Colorable k) (ha : ∀ s : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V) → s.card ≤ a) : Fintype.card V ≤ k * a
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k a : ℕ), G.Colorable k → (∀ (s : Finset V), G.IsIndepSet ↑s → s.card ≤ a) → Fintype.card V ≤ k * a
informal: n ≤ χ(G)·α(G) — the k colour classes are independent sets, each of size ≤ a, and they partition V (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise).

name: gr_regular_odd_degree_even_card
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (h : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) (hd : Odd d) : Even (Fintype.card V)
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ), G.IsRegularOfDegree d → Odd d → Even (Fintype.card V)
informal: A regular graph of odd degree has an even number of vertices — handshake lemma: n·d = 2e is even and d is odd.

name: p6_prop21_tangent
informal: Proposition 2.1 (Ford), first half: If det [[p,r],[q,s]] = ±1 then K[p,q] and K[r,s] are tangent [Tangent = externally tangent: distance of centres equals sum of radii; stated as an iff (stronger than printed). Finite circles only (q,s>0); the K[1,0] line convention is not formalised. Cited result (Ford 1938).]

name: gr_tree_two_leaves
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.IsTree) (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) : ∃ u v, u ≠ v ∧ G.degree u = 1 ∧ G.degree v = 1
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.IsTree → 2 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∃ u v, u ≠ v ∧ G.degree u = 1 ∧ G.degree v = 1
informal: A tree on at least two vertices has at least two leaves — ∑deg = 2e = 2(n−1) by the handshake lemma and SimpleGraph.IsTree.card_edgeFinset; every degree is ≥ 1 by connectedness; if at most one vertex had degree 1 the sum would be ≥ 2(n−1) + 1.

name: p6_prop21_disjoint
informal: Proposition 2.1 (Ford), second half: two distinct Ford circles ... otherwise, they are disjoint [Distinct circles read as p/q ≠ r/s i.e. ps-qr ≠ 0; disjoint = distance of centres exceeds sum of radii. Reducedness of the fractions is not needed.]

name: gr_bipartite_regular_parts_equal
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) (C : G.Coloring Bool) : (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => C v = true)).card = (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => C v = false)).card
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ), 0 < d → G.IsRegularOfDegree d → ∀ (C : G.Coloring Bool), {v | C v = true}.card = {v | C v = false}.card
informal: A regular bipartite graph of positive degree has colour classes of equal size — double count edges (darts from the true class): each edge has exactly one endpoint in each class, so d·|true class| = e = d·|false class|; cancel d.

name: gr_connected_of_ore_condition
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V] (h : ∀ u v, u ≠ v → ¬ G.Adj u v → Fintype.card V ≤ G.degree u + G.degree v + 1) : G.Connected
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V], (∀ (u v : V), u ≠ v → ¬G.Adj u v → Fintype.card V ≤ G.degree u + G.degree v + 1) → G.Connected
informal: Ore-type connectivity criterion generalising Mathlib2.comb_connected_of_min_degree_half: if deg u + deg v ≥ n − 1 for all non-adjacent u ≠ v then G is connected (indeed of diameter ≤ 2) — for non-adjacent u ≠ v the neighbour sets lie in V \ {u,v} of size n − 2 and have total size ≥ n − 1, so they intersect, giving a walk u-w-v.

name: p6_prop22_on_circles
informal: Proposition 2.2 (Kocik), formula (1): If K[p,q] and K[r,s] are tangent, their tangency point is ((pq+rs)/(q^2+s^2), 1/(q^2+s^2)) [The point (1) lies on both circles.]

name: p6_prop22_unique
informal: Proposition 2.2 (Kocik), uniqueness: ...their tangency point is (1) [Any common point of the two tangent circles is the point (1).]

name: gr_connected_of_many_edges
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : (Fintype.card V - 1).choose 2 < G.edgeFinset.card) : G.Connected
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], (Fintype.card V - 1).choose 2 < G.edgeFinset.card → G.Connected
informal: A graph with more than C(n−1,2) edges is connected — otherwise (using Mathlib2.comb_compl_connected_of_not_connected style splitting) V splits into nonempty parts of sizes k and n−k with no edges between, so e ≤ C(k,2) + C(n−k,2) ≤ C(n−1,2) for 1 ≤ k ≤ n−1.

name: p6_thm31_circle
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), (↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) + ↑k / 2) ^ 2 + (1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) ^ 2 = (↑k ^ 2 + 4) / 4
informal: Theorem 3.1 (Metallic circle): the points P_n=(f_{2n}/f_{2n+1}, 1/f_{2n+1}), n in Z, lie on C_k: (x+k/2)^2+y^2=(k^2+4)/4 [Stated for every integer k (paper: k>=1; the hypothesis is not needed).]

name: gr_self_compl_card_mod_four
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : Nonempty (SimpleGraph.Iso G Gᶜ)) : Fintype.card V % 4 = 0 ∨ Fintype.card V % 4 = 1
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Nonempty (G ≃g Gᶜ) → Fintype.card V % 4 = 0 ∨ Fintype.card V % 4 = 1
informal: A self-complementary graph has n ≡ 0 or 1 (mod 4) — an isomorphism gives a bijection of edge sets so e(G) = e(Gᶜ), and e(G) + e(Gᶜ) = n(n−1)/2, hence 4 ∣ n(n−1); as n, n−1 are coprime with one odd, 4 ∣ n or 4 ∣ n−1.

name: gr_set_union_ne_univ_card_le
statement: (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) : 2 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) → 2 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
informal: A family of subsets of [n] in which no two members (possibly equal) cover [n] has at most 2^(n−1) members — the family of complements is intersecting (Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ = (A ∪ B)ᶜ ≠ ∅), has the same cardinality, and Set.Intersecting.card_le applies; alternatively 𝒜 contains at most one of each complementary pair.

name: p6_thm31_feet
informal: Theorem 3.1, feet: C_k meets the X-axis at (σ_k^{-1},0) and (-σ_k,0) [Read as: the points of C_k on the axis are exactly these two.]

name: p6_cor32_step
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (n + 1))) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (n + 1) + 1)) - ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) = ↑k / (↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) * ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 3)))
informal: Proof of Corollary 3.2: x_{n+1}-x_n = k/(f_{2n+1} f_{2n+3})

name: p6_cor32_mono
statement: (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : StrictMono (fun n : ℤ => ((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ))
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), 1 ≤ k → StrictMono fun n => ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))
informal: Corollary 3.2, monotonicity: the abscissa x_n=f_{2n}/f_{2n+1} of P_n is strictly increasing in n in Z

name: p6_prop33_ford
informal: Proposition 3.3, first sentence: translation (x,y)→(x+j,y) and reflection (x,y)→(-x,y) preserve the family of Ford circles and map tangency points to tangency points [Formalised at the level of the labels: K[p,q]→K[p+jq,q], K[p,q]→K[-p,q]; determinant preserved up to sign and formula (1) transforms accordingly.]

name: p6_cor32_lim_top
statement: (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => ((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds ((((k : ℝ) + Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)⁻¹)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => 1 / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), 1 ≤ k → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds ((↑k + √(↑k ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)⁻¹) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
informal: Corollary 3.2 (12), n→+∞: lim_{n→+∞} P_n = (σ_k^{-1}, 0) [Coordinatewise convergence.]

name: gr_set_card_disjoint_pairs
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun p => Disjoint p.1 p.2)).card = 3 ^ n
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), {p | Disjoint p.1 p.2}.card = 3 ^ n
informal: The number of ordered pairs of disjoint subsets of [n] is 3ⁿ — the bijection (A,B) ↦ (A,Bᶜ) maps disjoint pairs onto pairs with A ⊆ Bᶜ; Uses Mathlib2.comb_card_subset_pairs at the last step for the count of subset pairs.

name: p6_cor32_lim_bot
statement: (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => ((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)) Filter.atBot (nhds (-(((k : ℝ) + Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4)) / 2))) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => 1 / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)) Filter.atBot (nhds 0)
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), 1 ≤ k → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) Filter.atBot (nhds (-((↑k + √(↑k ^ 2 + 4)) / 2))) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) Filter.atBot (nhds 0)
informal: Corollary 3.2 (12), n→-∞: lim_{n→-∞} P_n = (-σ_k, 0) [Coordinatewise convergence.]

name: p6_prop33_chain
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) + ↑k = ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 2)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) ∧ -(↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) = ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1) + 2)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1) + 1)) ∧ ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) = ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1) + 1)) ∧ (↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 2)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) - ↑k / 2) ^ 2 + (1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1))) ^ 2 = (↑k ^ 2 + 4) / 4
informal: Proposition 3.3, chain: translated point (f_{2n+2}/f_{2n+1},1/f_{2n+1}); reflected point with index n is the translated point with index -n-1; they lie on the circle with centre (k/2,0) and radius r_k

name: gr_set_antichain_card_le_half
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h : IsAntichain (· ⊆ ·) (𝒜 : Set (Finset (Fin n)))) : 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1)
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) ↑𝒜 → 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1)
informal: For n ≥ 1 an antichain of subsets of [n] has at most 2^(n−1) members — by Sperner (IsAntichain.sperner) |𝒜| ≤ C(n,⌊n/2⌋), and C(n,⌊n/2⌋) ≤ 2^(n−1) for n ≥ 1 since C(n,⌊n/2⌋) = C(n−1,⌊n/2⌋) + C(n−1,⌊n/2⌋−1) ≤ ∑_k C(n−1,k) (the two terms are distinct summands; for n = 1 it is 1 ≤ 1).

name: gr_set_inter_closed_eq_univ
statement: (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h1 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) ∈ 𝒜) (h2 : ∀ i : Fin n, (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase i ∈ 𝒜) (h3 : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∩ B ∈ 𝒜) : 𝒜 = Finset.univ
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), Finset.univ ∈ 𝒜 → (∀ (i : Fin n), Finset.univ.erase i ∈ 𝒜) → (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∩ B ∈ 𝒜) → 𝒜 = Finset.univ
informal: An intersection-closed family containing [n] and all co-singletons is the whole power set — prove S ∈ 𝒜 by induction on |Sᶜ| (Finset.induction on the complement): S = univ is h1, and removing one more point i is S ∩ (univ.erase i).

name: p6_rem34
type: ∀ (k n : ℤ), -↑k - ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) = ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1))) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1) + 1)) ∧ 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) = 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * (-n - 1) + 1))
informal: Remark 3.4: the symmetry (x,y)→(-k-x,y) swaps P_n and P_{-n-1}

name: p6_prop33_feet
informal: Proposition 3.3, feet: which meets the axis at (σ_k,0) and (-σ_k^{-1},0)

name: gr_set_sum_card_inter_pairs
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ p : Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n), (p.1 ∩ p.2).card = n * 4 ^ (n - 1)
informal: ∑ over ordered pairs (A,B) of subsets of [n] of |A ∩ B| equals n·4^(n−1) — write |A ∩ B| = ∑_i 1[i ∈ A ∧ i ∈ B], swap sums; for fixed i the number of pairs with i in both is 2^(n−1)·2^(n−1).

name: gr_set_intersecting_union_free_quarter
statement: (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (h1 : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, (A ∩ B).Nonempty) (h2 : ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) : 4 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, (A ∩ B).Nonempty) → (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ∪ B ≠ Finset.univ) → 4 * 𝒜.card ≤ 2 ^ n
informal: Daykin–Lovász/Seymour: a family that is both intersecting and co-intersecting has at most 2^(n−2) members — let 𝒰 be the up-closure and 𝒟 the down-closure of 𝒜; 𝒰 is intersecting so |𝒰| ≤ 2^(n−1), 𝒟 is union-free so |𝒟| ≤ 2^(n−1) (cf. gr_set_union_ne_univ_card_le), and by Harris–Kleitman (IsUpperSet.card_inter_le_finset) 2ⁿ·|𝒜| ≤ 2ⁿ·|𝒰 ∩ 𝒟| ≤ |𝒰|·|𝒟| ≤ 4^(n−1)·... giving |𝒜| ≤ 2^(n−2).

name: p6_arsinh_metallic
statement: (k : ℤ) : Real.arsinh ((k : ℝ) / 2) = Real.log (((k : ℝ) + Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), Real.arsinh (↑k / 2) = Real.log ((↑k + √(↑k ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)
informal: Proof of Corollary 3.6: arcsinh(k/2) = ln σ_k

name: p6_lem35
informal: Lemma 3.5: p/q, r/s fractions with ps-qr=±1, a>=1 integer, (u,v)=a(r,s)+(p,q); T, T' tangency points of K[p,q],K[r,s] and K[r,s],K[u,v]: d_H(T,T') = 2 arcsinh(a/2) [Tangency points given by formula (1); d_H is Mathlib's hyperbolic distance on the upper half-plane. As printed there are no sign conditions on q, s, v (the formula (1) is used also for q=0 / negative denominators, per the paper's footnote).]

name: p6_cor36
statement: (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (m n : ℤ) (P Q : UpperHalfPlane) (hP : (P : ℂ) = ⟨((p6_kfib k (2 * m) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * m + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ), 1 / ((p6_kfib k (2 * m + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)⟩) (hQ : (Q : ℂ) = ⟨((p6_kfib k (2 * n) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ), 1 / ((p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)⟩) : dist P Q = 2 * |((m - n : ℤ) : ℝ)| * Real.log (((k : ℝ) + Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), 1 ≤ k → ∀ (m n : ℤ) (P Q : UpperHalfPlane), ↑P = { re := ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * m)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * m + 1)), im := 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * m + 1)) } → ↑Q = { re := ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n)) / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)), im := 1 / ↑(Mathlib2.p6_kfib k (2 * n + 1)) } → dist P Q = 2 * |↑(m - n)| * Real.log ((↑k + √(↑k ^ 2 + 4)) / 2)
informal: Corollary 3.6 (Equidistance): d_H(P_m,P_n) = 2|m-n| ln σ_k, m,n in Z

name: p6_prop22_inf_point
informal: Proposition 2.2 (Kocik), circle at infinity: First conjunct: formula (1) with (p,q,r,s)=(1,0,r,1) evaluates to (r,1). Second: (r,1) is the unique common point of the line y=1 and K[r,1].
source: arXiv:2611.07141v1 Prop 2.1/2.2, infinity case added after independent review

name: p6_prop21_inf_tangent
informal: Proposition 2.1 (Ford), circle at infinity, tangency: K[r,s] has centre height 1/(2s^2) and radius 1/(2s^2); the line y=1 is tangent to it iff the gap 1 - 1/(2s^2) equals the radius. Determinant written literally for (p,q)=(1,0).
source: arXiv:2611.07141v1 Prop 2.1/2.2, infinity case added after independent review

name: p6_prop21_inf_disjoint
informal: Proposition 2.1 (Ford), circle at infinity, disjointness: Disjoint from the line y=1 means the radius is smaller than the distance from the centre to the line.
source: arXiv:2611.07141v1 Prop 2.1/2.2, infinity case added after independent review

name: lw_55950
informal: If $ x^2-3x+1=0 $ , what is the value of $ x^2 + (1/x)^2? $

name: lw_8296
informal: If $x^2 + 1/x^2 = 3$ , what is the value of $\dfrac{x^2}{(x^2+1)^2}$ ?\nSource: MATHCOUNTS 2012 Chapter #29
